units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:2">Ḥull. III, 2</cite> <he>נשברה הש׳ ולא וכ׳</he> if the spinal column is broken, but its cord is not severed.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 28:3">Gen. R. s. 28</cite>, beg., a. e. <he>לוז של ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="L00226"><he>לוּז</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 147b:16">Sabb. 147ᵇ</cite> <he>חומרי ש׳</he> Rashi (ed. <he>שדרא</he>) the knots of the spine(vertebræ). Ohol. I, 8, v. <cite ref="H00347"><he>חוּלְיָא</he> I</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 16a:22">B. Kam. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>שִׁדְרוֹ של אדם</he> a man’s spine.
<cite ref="Berakhot 55a">Ber. 55ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 81a:8">Sabb. 81ᵃ</cite> <he>שדרו של דג</he> the back-bone of a fish.—Pl. <he>שִׁדְרָאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Niddah 24a:65">Nidd. 24ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:2">Bekh. VII, 2</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 60b:7">Ḥull. 60ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C00031"><he>גַּב</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 30:14">Lev. R. s. 30</cite> <he>הש׳ של לולב דומה לש׳ וכ׳</he> the rib of the palm-branch resembles the spinal column of man. ‘<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 1:2">Ukts. I, 2</cite> <he>הש׳ של שבולת</he> the stem of an ear (of wheat).
<cite ref="Chullin 119b">Ḥull. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>בש׳</he> it refers to the stem of an ear of wheat, v. <he>שׁוֹמֵר</he>; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="U00608"><he>שִׁזְרָה</he></cite>.
